full_prompt_en: The image is a square black-and-white photograph of an older man seated close to the camera with his chin resting on a closed fist. His head turns slightly toward the left, while his wide eyes look directly toward the viewer. Thick wavy hair rises above a deeply lined forehead. Wrinkles around the eyes, cheeks, and mouth are clearly visible, giving the face a lived-in texture. He wears a dark jacket over a white shirt and a dark tie. His fist sits at the lower center, partly blocking the shirt collar and providing a physical support for the pose. The nearest side of the face receives soft light from the left, illuminating the forehead, eye, nose, and hand. The far side of the cheek and jacket falls into dark gray and black. Behind him, a bookshelf or row of books appears at the left, but the spines are blurred and largely unreadable. The right background is darker and less defined. The camera is close, cropping the torso at the shoulders and lower chest, so the face and hand dominate the frame. Film grain and gentle optical softness are visible, particularly in the backdrop, while the eyes and facial creases remain sharply observed. The grayscale range is wide but not flashy: pale highlights on skin and shirt, medium gray hair and wall, rich black suit and shadows. There is no smile or overt action. The expression is watchful, weary, and reflective. The composition uses the diagonal of the leaning head and the fist beneath it to make a simple, stable triangle. Its impact comes from direct gaze, naturally textured skin, carefully placed side light, and the subdued suggestion of a room full of books.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形黑白照片，一位年长男子坐在镜头近处，闭合的拳头托着下巴。头略向左转，睁大的眼却直望观者。浓密波浪发在布满深纹的额头上升起。眼、颊和嘴周围皱纹清楚可见，让脸有生活痕迹。他穿深外套、白衬衫和深领带。拳头位于下方中央，局部挡住衣领，并实际支撑姿态。脸的近侧从左边接住柔光，照亮额、眼、鼻和手。远侧脸颊与外套落入深灰和黑。身后左侧似乎有书架或一排书，但书脊模糊、基本不可读。右背景更暗且不清楚。相机很近，躯干在肩与下胸处被裁切，因此脸和手占主导。胶片颗粒和温和光学柔化可见，特别是背景，眼与面部皱褶仍观察清楚。灰阶范围宽但不炫目：皮肤和衬衫浅亮，头发和墙中灰，西服与阴影浓黑。没有微笑或明显动作。神情警觉、疲惫而沉思。构图用倾斜的头和下面的拳构成简单稳定的三角形。其力量来自直接目光、自然皮肤肌理、仔细放置的侧光和满是书的房间所提供的含蓄暗示。
style_prompt_en: Intimate black-and-white photography places a sharply observed face or focal texture against a subdued, softly blurred interior. Directional side light reveals wrinkles, pores, hair, and a supporting gesture without turning the image into hard theatrical chiaroscuro. A dark jacket or equivalent large mass anchors the lower frame; pale shirt or skin accents create a restrained tonal path toward the eyes. Fine film grain and gentle background softness keep attention close. The composition favors a steady triangular arrangement of head, hand, and shoulder. The result is humane, reflective, and unvarnished, with direct gaze and naturally aged surfaces carrying the emotional force.
style_prompt_zh: 亲密的黑白摄影把观察清楚的脸或焦点肌理置于克制、柔焦的室内前。定向侧光显露皱纹、毛孔、头发和支撑姿势，却没有把图像变成硬舞台明暗。深外套或相当的大体块固定画幅下部；浅衬衫或皮肤重点构成通向双眼的克制调子路径。细胶片颗粒与柔和背景使注意力保持贴近。构图偏向由头、手、肩组成的稳定三角。结果有人情味、沉思且不加粉饰，由直接目光和自然老化表面承载情感力量。
theme_en: A thoughtful older man resting his chin on his fist in monochrome
theme_zh: 一位年长男子在黑白照片中以拳托腮沉思
name: Jean Cocteau
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
